writeup: TIC 158864044 is a candidate eclipsing binary star with an orbital period of 5.7156 days. Automated analysis of TESS photometry detected a primary eclipse causing 16.36% dimming, with a detection significance of 187.9 on the BLS scale. No secondary eclipse was detected. Pixel-level image analysis confirmed the signal at a peak signal-to-noise ratio of 48.9, though the centroid offset of 3.5 arcsec from the target position warrants consideration. The candidate does not appear in six major variable-star catalogs. A machine-learning classifier assigned it a score of 0.38 out of 1.0 for likelihood of being a real stellar system. All automated data quality checks passed without flags, supporting the validity of this candidate for further investigation.
